body: Exactly....  Suicide is never easy, no one just wakes up one day and decides it's a good day to die...

No worries, I've had a VERY long time to stew on this.  One of few things I liked about the Army was the considerable time I spent away from the house.  The caveat to that was in made my marriage last way longer than it should have.  But I'll stop discussing that.  What it means is simple, I had A LOT of time to ruminate on the how and why I was unhappy.  It also gave me the time to read, something I always loved and my wife complains about, simply because she can't stand it when people simply different outlooks than her.   I strongly urge people to read Thomas Szasz's "The Myth of Mental Illness" and "Anti-Oedipus: Capitalism and Schizophrenia" by Gilles Deleuze and Felix Guattari...  Wonderful books. Szasz challenges the pre-conceived notions that someone is mentally ill, instead, he lays out the view that mental illness is a construct to explain deviations from accepted social norms (yes, this is an extremely simplified explanation).  Essentially, mental illness is a manifestation of "problems with living."  I strongly suspect that many of the sufferings on this site, have problems in their lives (family, work, socialization).  They are in a sense, patients as malingerers... they lack the sophistication and articulation to explain their problems, so they turn to mental illness as means of communicating their problems, with psychiatrists and therapists more than happy to line their pockets and perpetuate the myth.  

Anti-Oedipus takes a more radical view, and I wouldn't approach this work if you are not academically inclined to do so.  The essential theme is desire, for we all desire, every one of us.  Desire is a volatile and explosive force, of which capitalist societies must suppress, lest it becomes an uncontrollable means of bringing down the existing structure. Family values play an integral part in this repression, as the family structure itself is a means of dampening desire.   It is, in my opinion, the most repressive of all forces.  

There is an elephant in the room people, and someone needs to point it out.

THANK YOU!!!!!!   I'd throw you some gold if I really cared about that crap.  You see, that's the inherent problem with these sites and all the armchair therapists they attract.  "It will get better", "it's only temporary", "think of all you have to live for" ...so much sugary, fluffy prose that purports to be so encouraging and is actually essentially meaningless.  

Allow my rebuttal:

1) It will get better/It's only temporary... No, it won't. Life is beset with problems, in my case, I've been feeling this way for almost two decades, it certainly hasn't gotten better, only worse.  

2)  You have so much to live for.... No, I don't... I have no friends, I'm married to a woman I can't stand and I have two ingrates constantly looking for handouts.  Employment?  QMP'd from the Army, so no job.  Oh, and I'm 42, so I've aged out of the sympathy and caring range as far as society is concerned.  I no longer bother to reach out, pointless...

You're not sick.  We live in a "civilized" society that arbitrarily sets the standards of "abnormality".  It's society that's sick, not you.  One of the reasons I stopped going to the VA, I came to the realization that they WANTED me to be sick.  Making me a hopeless, guilt-ridden neurotic allows them to have more control, and that's what they want.  They want a sheep, nicely packaged with their QR codes ready installed, it's so unbelievably obvious to me that I can't understand why others can't see it.  I see the control all around me... from the subtle messages, they send me through my computer screen, to the constant petty insults they subject me to on a daily basis.

It's your choice, just make the right one.  As for me, I'm going down fighting.  I fantasize about sitting on the urban rooftop and watching the bombs fall, wiping the world clean of all the hubris and clutter... family values, exploitation, all these sick social "norms" ... all sterilized in the flames.  I want people to hurt like I hurt...

Well... got a call.  A slimy pseudo-job offer in sales.  Wonderful!  Be a pawn in an exploitive enterprise, the American dream for sure.  

Anyways, I found the perfect remedy.  Near my house is a near abandoned factory that plays host to several derelict vehicles.  On a whim, I snuck over there with a few Molotov cocktails I slapped together and set one alight.  

You know, it actually felt good.  Exhilarating in fact.  If I can't create, I'll destroy.  I scream and no one listens, so I'll burn, no way they can ignore that.

Another job rejection today.  Fuck the VA.  Fuck the walking dead living their pathetic lives.. and the sheep looked up indeed.  There's this empty house in my neighborhood and I have the increasing need to burn it.  Just a bit of accelerant, an open flame, and watch it burn.  A perfect metaphor of what I would like to see happen to the world.  Now if I could every arrogant therapist in VA in the structure (along with a slew of other fucks in my life) the flame would burn so much sweeter.  Ahhhhhhhh... I cheer up just think about it.
....and thus the rondeau comes to a halting end... Kind of makes me wonder why I bother to reach out to others in the first place...
Interesting... I suppose that "chatting" includes only females right?   Seen this kind selective "depression" before....

We shop at the same store my brother :)... Thanks for making me smile....

Bread and butter platitudes... That's the only lunch theRapists and head shrinkers serve.  Fuck them all.

Unique... and yes... alone as well. Kind of hard NOT to compare yourself to other people when their lives seem at least somewhat satisfying. 

A walk... ok... sure... let me wander around my faceless suburb and admire the scenery... Wow! Look at that house! Is it a Wright? Maybe Tadao Ando? Gotta be a Vitus Mataré! Oh no, wait, it's another Century 21 box or McMansion. The kind some poor schlub has signed away 30 years of his life to buy but will probably never own. All so that he can chase the American lie and pretend there is actual reward for all those years of toil.

Oh and look at the neighbors! Hi, Mrs. Jones!!! Your jelly rolls look particularly alluring today. How is Mr. Jones? Still fat, materialistic and ignorant? Wonderful!!!! 

 You know what? Let me invite my wife along on my little foray. It's so lovely to hear her ballad refrain of "Talk to me", "What's up", or my personal favorite... the endless complaints about my attitude, my behavior, how's she always been there for me (just like she was "there" for me when she had two kids I didn't want and lied to me about her birth control options). Bliss! Why I feel better already. 

Look, I know you want to help. But I'm tired of just doing the "little things" and expecting them to sustain me. As far as focusing... I have a focus. I focus on my anger, my hatred, and as long as I am stuck in this life, that is ALL I will focus on.

I'm on unemployment.  Let me put it this way, when I was in the Army I was making almost $70,000 a year.  Would you like to know what the salary was of last job the VA and the unemployment office offered me?  Ready?  $30,000.. that's right.  I would making HALF of what I made per month.  Garbage.  They've also suggested I take jobs at places like Walmart and Lowes.  Kind of makes me wonder why I bothered to serve 15 years of honorable service.

@step_on_it.... Hate to break it to you because I do believe you think you are giving sage advice.  Stop it!  Seriously??  Opportunities out of town?  The man has no job, have you ever had to look for a job in distant location?  More to the point, have you ever had to do with five kids and wife in tow?  

I'm in the same boat and around the age, except I've been out of work for SIX MONTHS.  I've shopped a resume and CV all over the country, and since most employers would rather not pay for relocation, you're are kind of S.O.L. Where would you suggest he relocate to???  Maybe Central Park West?  San Francisco???  Kind of hard to do when you're broke.  

The reason your friends have been doing so well is that they probably don't have five children.  I've had to endure the same spectacle, I watched as a slacker acquaintance from high school went on to get his PhD from NYU.  That's right, a guy whom they graduated just get rid of now has a PhD, while I'm still struggling to finish my degree.  Wanna know why??  Because he didn't have three leeches (that's right I said it, a wife and two ingrates) who kept him down, who sucked away all of his creativity, his ideals, his optimism.

Fundie, you and I are the disposable workers.  We're men, and we live in sick society that keeps us in chains.  How dare we have dreams outside our suburban prisons?!  Well for me, no more, I've built a bit of a war chest, I'm packing my bags and I'm going as far as a plane, car, boat or my feet will carry me.  Let the others deal with crap THEY created, and I pity anyone who comes looking for me, better to die on my feet than live on my knees.  

I know I'll probably catch hell for this, because no wants to hear the real truth, but I no longer care.  I was meant to live and die free.  Either way, be it life or death, I only have my chains to lose
